faq.a: We provide comprehensive dental care including cleanings, preventive care, implants, crowns, wisdom teeth removal, cosmetic dentistry, and treatment for sleep apnea and TMJ disorders.
Monday through Wednesday, 7 AM to 4 PM. Thursday, 7 AM to 3 PM. Friday, 8 AM to 1 PM. Closed Saturday and Sunday.

faq.q: Can I request an appointment after hours?
faq.a: Yes. Use the booking form anytime, even after hours or on weekends. We'll get back to you to confirm your appointment.
We're at 300 Billingsley Road, Charlotte, NC. You can call us at (704) 347-2557 for directions or parking details.
